purpose: The fast-path gate. Every task is fast-path eligible, answerable by reading this repository, and has an acceptance criterion that is decided by a string check rather than by a judgement.
why_mechanical: A model judging a model is another instrument to validate before it can be trusted. These questions were chosen so the answer is a fact this repository already states, which keeps the instrument out of the argument.
ground_truth_taken: 2026-09-28 at commit c6f182e, by reading the files directly. Recorded so a later disagreement can be settled against the repository rather than against memory.
